page.notes: The handwritten mark at the top right ("3" with a stroke) is ink annotation, not printed, and is left out. A small symbol stands before "Apostolis" in the syllogism and is probably a printer's mark or ink stroke; it is not transcribed. The abbreviation at the end of the line "q" / "cū dixerit" (quum) is split across the line break and its exact form is doubtful, hence [?]. The catchword "in" is read from the lower right and is doubtful.
